definitions.short: properly, to be broken up (with any violent action) i.e. (figuratively) to fear
definitions.usage: be grevious (only Isaiah 15:4; the rest belong to 7489 ).
definitions.full: H3415. yara [ יָרַע ] verb quiver (compare Arabic be timid, weak ; pious fear ; יְרַע ᵑ7 be disheartened ) — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular לוֺ יָָֽרְעָה נַפְשׁוֺ Isa 15:4 his soul quivereth to him, i.e. is in terror and distress.

occurrences.englishText: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”

David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants, and pursue after him, lest he get himself fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.”
All darkness is laid up for his treasures.
Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.
